verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair axis for a password manager or authenticator, since products of this kind can ship CLIs, service accounts or scripting. Nothing in 2FAS's evidence shows user-configurable automations that run on their own in the background. Encrypted iCloud/Google Drive sync is passive backup, not user-defined automation, and the site's own llms.txt states 'Public API: None', so there is no endpoint to drive automated workflows.
